response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack development skills and a passion for open-source projects, but his experience lacks depth in C++ for industrial automation and secure development practices, which are critical for this role. His background in TypeScript, Node.js, and AI-agent infrastructure is impressive but not directly aligned with the core requirements of this position.
strengths: Extensive experience with event-driven architectures and distributed systems, relevant to IoT and message-broker-based applications.
Proven leadership in mentoring teams and organizing technical workshops, indicating strong collaboration and knowledge-sharing skills.
Diverse technical background with exposure to multiple programming languages and frameworks, showcasing adaptability and problem-solving abilities.
concerns: Limited recent hands-on experience with C++ and STL, which are core requirements for this role.
No explicit mention of secure development lifecycle (SDL) practices or industrial cybersecurity standards (e.g., IEC 62443).
Most recent roles focus on full-stack web development (TypeScript, Node.js, React), which diverges from the role's emphasis on C++ and industrial automation.
